create_poll_post.description: Ask a question with two to four answers, open for a day, three days or a week. Mark one answer correct and it becomes a quiz, with an optional explanation shown after voting. This is the one Nuelink post that does not need a caption, because the question stands in for it - though you can still add one. Polls only appear on the platforms that have them; the rest of the collection gets the caption.

create_post.description: Write one post and let Nuelink publish it now, queue it, schedule it for an exact time, or save it as a draft. It goes to every channel in the collection you choose and to no others - that is what a collection is for. Attach media by uploading it first or by giving Nuelink a public URL, add an auto-comment for the links and hashtags, and set the Instagram, Facebook or TikTok options where they apply. Nuelink's API cannot edit or delete a post afterwards, and reports no per-channel result - check the Nuelink dashboard for what each platform did with it.

Nuelink has no search, so this reads the brand list and matches on the brand's 'title' - an exact match first, then a partial one. Nuelink's own documentation calls this the way to check that a token still works, and it is the only action here that needs nothing but the token. There is no email address or plan on it, whatever Nuelink's assistant documentation says.

upload_media.description: Upload one image, video or PDF to a brand and get back the media ID a post attaches it by. Nuelink takes a single file per upload, up to 100 MB, as PNG, JPG, MP4, MOV or PDF. Each social platform then applies its own limits on top - Instagram caps video length, TikTok wants certain aspect ratios - so a file Nuelink accepts here can still be refused at publish time. Uploads cannot be listed or deleted through the API afterwards.

description: Schedule and publish social media from a workflow: write one post and let Nuelink send it to every account in a collection - Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube, Threads, Pinterest, X, Bluesky, Mastodon, Telegram and Google Business - now, at a set time, or at the next free slot in the brand's queue. Upload media, add polls, quizzes, Stories and auto-comments, and check which connected accounts have dropped out.
